description: The secret files of the Windows-container deployment, by service directory under MACHVON_SECRETS_DIR (default C:\ProgramData\MACHVON\secrets). Each service mounts ITS directory only, read-only, at C:\run\secrets. Access list of every directory: SYSTEM and Administrators full control, ContainerUser (S-1-5-93-2-2) read, nobody else. host\secrets.ps1 creates what does not exist and never replaces a file; no value is in git, in an image, in the compose file or in the environment file.

secrets.name: db_owner_password
secrets.purpose: Password of machvon_owner (owner of the schema; migrations and backups)

secrets.name: keycloak_db_password
secrets.purpose: Password of the keycloak role, read once when the cluster is created

secrets.name: keycloak_db_password
secrets.purpose: The same value, read by Keycloak

secrets.name: keycloak_admin_password
secrets.purpose: Password of the first administrator of Keycloak (KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USER), used by host\keycloak-admin.ps1

secrets.name: ldap_bind_credential
secrets.purpose: Bind password of the directory service account; a random placeholder while no directory is connected

secrets.name: database_url_app
secrets.purpose: Connection of the tenant plane (machvon_app, row level security applies)

secrets.name: tenant_token_signing_key
secrets.purpose: Signs the tenant tokens (EC P-256 private key, PEM)
secrets.generate: made by the Node of the api image

secrets.name: license_signing_key
secrets.generate: made by the Node of the api image

secrets.name: field_encryption_keys
secrets.purpose: Keys of the encrypted columns: <version>:<32 random bytes, base64>. LOSING IT MAKES THOSE COLUMNS UNREADABLE: keep an offline copy

secrets.name: tls_cert
secrets.purpose: Certificate chain of the public host (PEM)
What only a person reads: the first accounts and their passwords. Mounted by no service; readable by Administrators and SYSTEM only
